Exact 1 GHz iOS clock specialization; preserve u64 clock-scale wrap and offset ordering. Empty volatile asm retains the frequency branch without emitting instructions or a CPU fence under LLVM 22/A18.
Reserve each typed descriptor pool only on first use at its original full capacity while empty; preserve deferred pointer stability and reuse.
Coalesce repeated descriptor flush registrations under the existing manager mutex; reset membership on flush, deregistration and destruction.

changes: Skip speculative texture hashes for recorded validations that must bypass worker results; retain sequence/epoch order and synchronous validation.
Bounded recent completed-shader hints with exact owned-key comparison, instruction-mask guard and synchronized publication/lifetime.
Retain only Vulkan dynamic states declared dynamic by the actual next graphics pipeline; invalidate static/unknown states and reset per command buffer.
After the original first VM allocation probe, skip occupied map intervals under the existing writer lock; preserve first-fit address and page-table fallback.
